correctness.rationale: Petersen P is Kneser KG(5,2): graph vertices are ten 2-subsets of five letters, with fifteen graph edges. NM_3(P) has simplicial vertices equal to graph *edges* and includes exactly those edge sets containing no three pairwise-disjoint graph edges. There are 145 forbidden triples and exactly 1073 augmented faces, with face vector (1,15,105,310,405,207,30); an independently implemented full 2^15 mask scan reproduced these counts. The inspected exact discrete-Morse code finds 530 matched pairs, acyclic Hasse orientation on all 1072 nonempty faces, and one critical vertex, ten critical 3-cells, one critical 4-cell. Signed Morse attaching differential (0,0,1,0,1,1,1,1,1,1) is primitive; a homotopy-invertible unimodular basis change removes one 3-sphere with the 4-cell, yielding wedge^9 S3. The S5 action induced on graph edge subsets has third-homology trace equal to the number of fixed two-subsets minus one for each conjugacy class; an independently written full 120-permutation signed Lefschetz face computation verified the entire character and hence rational S^(4,1) plus S^(3,2). The independent mask/character check supplements, and does not alone substitute for, the inspected exact Morse attaching code.
